newsitem.title: INDIA: India set for financial services boom -- ICICI.
newsitem.headline: India set for financial services boom -- ICICI.

text.p: India's financial services sector is ready to register huge growth following the completion of a major round of reforms over the past few years, Narayanan Vaghul, the chairman of the Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India Ltd (ICICI) said on Friday.
"We have substantially carried out all reforms," Vaghul told a business conference in New Delhi.
"The financial market is set for a major explosion in the next two years," Vaghul said. He did not elaborate.
